title: GDAL 3.11.5 authenticated OAPIF compatibility with project records

source.description: Version-pinned GDAL OAPIF driver consumes the real shared-auth and project-scoped Records route over loopback HTTP.

expectedOutcomes.assertion: GDAL is denied without shared authority, then discovers the resources collection and reads the governed record schema and feature through the real application route.
The external GIS driver reconstructs the polygon record and forwards a spatial filter as an OAPIF bbox query without creating a conformance claim.
